d:
Svatantrata sangram ke gumnam nayak batukeshvar datt apni janmajyanti 18 navanbar ke mauke par yad kiya ja rahe hain. batukeshvar datt aise svatantrata senani the jinhonne angrejon ke dant khatte kar die the. bhagat sinh, sukhdev aur rajguru svatantrata sangram ke nayak the aur inke aandolan men sakriy rahe batukeshvar datt gumnami ke andhere men hi rah gae.
